text.offer: Widow Qesino says, "There's an ancient place in the mountains near here, its origin forgotten, and under it a city that sank into the earth. Brax. The dead come from there, the old folk say. I wouldn't send anyone, but you're not anyone. Go, and come back."
text.complete: You have struck at the heart of the undead threat. The dead of Brax will not rest easy, but neither will their Queen.

steps.objective: Find the Ancient City of Brax
steps.brief: Deep in the mountains lies an ancient city that was buried under the earth due to some sort of catastrophe. At an ancient place, its origin forgotten, find the entrance to the underground city. Within lurks something timeless and evil.

This place holds the source of the undead plaguing the land. The horrors of Brax serve a Queen who doomed this city to sink under the earth. Strike at them: destroy twelve of the undead within the city.
